description: Found by Elixir Parity (2026-11-20). `import Mod` inside a def body fails with 'unsupported expression prefix in compiler2 front door: Import'. Elixir allows lexical import, require and alias in function bodies, scoped to the rest of the body. Once it works, a def emitted by an item macro can hold a macro call only the body expander expands; fz-mue.38's disjoint counter ranges already cover that. Owner: Elixir Parity. Related: fz-p8p.21 (ambiguous imports).
title: import, require and alias work inside a function body, as in Elixir
